mutableStatePolicy: Read live pull request URLs, base and head SHAs, states, and checks from GitHub and the pull request bodies. Never store them here.
reconstructionPolicy: Each reconstructionCommit is the original immutable byte-for-byte whole-file or explicit split slice retained by reconstructionRef. Rebases and safety follow-up commits can change live branch heads but never these records.
